name: LivPadel Malkerns
geoNote: Malkerns town pin — Malkerns Square named on operator site; plus code F5GV+FR2 cited by a directory but not independently reverse-geocoded
description: LivPadel Malkerns brings three purpose-built padel courts to Malkerns Square — Eswatini’s first dedicated LivPadel site with PadelMates booking, racket hire and on-site amenities. A clear recommendation when you want bookable padel in the Manzini belt rather than crossing into South Africa. Reserve ahead for evening lights; opening coverage places the courts as the country’s debut facility.
sourceTypes: LivPadel first-party club page; local launch coverage; TrustPadel
researchNotes: Three courts from July 2025 launch coverage; operator hours 06:00–22:00 on club page
